 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 4141/2024 Sachin S/o Shri Sher Ji, Aged About 19 Years, R/o Madariyon Ka Bas, Sumerpur, Dist. Pali.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
(Presently Lodged At Central Jail,
Jodhpur)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. JVS Deora For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Sharma, PP  Mr. R.R. Ankiya for complainant  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 16/04/2024

This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.108/2024 registered at Police Station Kudi Bhagtasni, Jodhpur City West, for offence under Section 376(2)(n) of the IPC.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner contended that the petitioner, who is aged about 19 years, has been falsely implicated in the present case.

Learned counsel submitted that the prosecutrix, who is aged about 18 years, was having consensual relationship with the present petitioner, however, on relation between them turning strained, the petitioner has been roped in criminal case.

Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner is in [2024:RJ-JD:16345] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-4141/2024]
judicial custody; no recovery is due to be made from him and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Per Contra, Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.

This Court vide order dated 08.04.2024 directed learned Public Prosecutor to produce the case diary.
In compliance of the aforesaid order, case diary has been produced before this Court.

Having perused the statements of the prosecutrix recorded before the competent criminal court under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., this Court prima facie finds that as per prosecutrix, the petitioner had mixed some intoxicant substance in the cold drink of the prosecutrix and after consuming the cold drink she fell unconscious and thereupon, the petitioner subjected her to sexual assault.

This Court prima facie finds that though, as per prosecutrix she was made to consume a cold drink containing intoxicant substance and thereafter, she was subjected to blackmailing and sexual assault by the present petitioner.

However, at the same time this Court finds that prosecutrix in her statements recorded before the competent criminal court has stated that she had remained in the company of the present petitioner for about 20 days and travelled with him to various places using public transportation.

This Court also finds that a numbers of calls have been exchanged between the petitioner and prosecutrix on different occasions indicating the fact that the prosecutrix was in constant touch with the petitioner.

This Court also finds that the [2024:RJ-JD:16345] (3 of 3)
[CRLMB-4141/2024] petitioner who is aged about 19 years is in judicial custody and the prosecution has not shown any apprehension of him influencing the prosecution witnesses or tampering with the evidence, in case he is enlarged on bail.
Thus, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Sachin S/o Shri Sher Ji arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.108/2024 registered at Police Station Kudi Bhagtasni, District Jodhpur City West, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
It is however, made clear that findings recorded/observations made above are for limited purposes of adjudication of bail application.
The trial court shall not get prejudiced by the same.

(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 35-mohit/-
